name: Sales Deck
description: A polished sales presentation for client meetings or demos
layout_notes: Target 10–15 slides. Lead with the client's problem, not company credentials. Use visuals over text-heavy slides.

required_sections.title: Title Slide
required_sections.description: Company logo, deck title, client name, date, presenter name

required_sections.title: Agenda
required_sections.description: Brief overview of what will be covered

required_sections.title: The Problem We Solve
required_sections.description: Frame the pain point the client faces — make them feel understood

required_sections.title: Our Solution
required_sections.description: How we solve that problem — lead with outcomes, not features

required_sections.title: How It Works
required_sections.description: A simple visual or process showing the approach

required_sections.title: What We Offer
required_sections.description: Key services or products relevant to this client

required_sections.title: Proof Points
required_sections.description: 1–2 client results — stats and brief story

required_sections.title: Who You'll Work With
required_sections.description: Key team members for this engagement

required_sections.title: Next Steps
required_sections.description: Clear, specific actions for the client

optional_sections.title: Investment
optional_sections.include_when: client has asked for pricing or it is appropriate to include

instance_inputs.label: Context for this meeting (e.g. 'first discovery call', 'proposal follow-up')
